name: Outlaw Tools v0.11.1
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.11.1

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.11.1

## Safer Data Refresh

- Check every joined Blueprint/mission source build before activating refreshed catalogs. Preserve missing declarations as unknown; reject conflicting patch/channel and known exact-build evidence.
- Discard refresh candidates when the selected game folder or installed build changes during download. Retain previous caches and offer a retry.
- Skip overlapping resource or catalog refresh requests without queuing duplicate network work; show a retry message instead of false success. Blueprint and mission updates share the existing atomic pair/rollback path.
- Verify the mining payload's own declaration, including SCMDb responses, rather than relying on the requested URL or launcher manifest alone.

## Local Data

- No player-data migration, new dependency, background service or visual redesign. Existing offline references remain available. Runtime source URLs remain separate from the release-time pinned snapshot pipeline.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums.
